title: Existence of exact graded presentation data
statement: For a closed immersion j and an invertible module L with square-zero ideal, there exists a TensorGradedPresentationCore j L containing all algebra, exactness, quotient, kernel, colimit, and projection data of the graded presentation, except the homogeneous multiplication equation.

proof.text: Obtain the graded algebra quotient A, its canonical degree data D, and the square-zero kernel theorem. Construct the core explicitly with I=kernel(p), i=kernel.ι(p), and the fields of A and D. For the full presentation use A.b_multiply; the universal multiplication assertion for arbitrary cores is not used.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09MS, direct-sum ideal sequence; N1 explicit kernel assembly
